question_en: Why are conductors and corresponding terminals labelled after starter maintenance?
options: Base the decision only on equipment age.
Use only the enclosure colour as the reference.
Rely only on purchase records instead of technical information.
explanation_en: The RSOS requires conductor/terminal labelling according to drawings and specifications.
explanation_es: El RSOS exige etiquetado de conductores/terminales de acuerdo con planos y especificaciones.
